tagline: We provide investment management and related services to institutions and individuals.
hero_kpi_rationale: Assets Under Management is the primary revenue driver in the asset management model, as fees are proportional to AUM. It is the fundamental KPI of the business model.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed for clients, basis for fee calculation.
kpis.description: AUM decreased 8.9% in 2025 to $159.5 billion, due to net outflows of $18.9 billion, partially offset by positive market performance of $5.9 billion.
kpis.signal: AUM decline in 2025 despite positive market performance.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from fees on assets under management.
kpis.description: Total revenues declined 6.0% in 2025 to $852.9 million, reflecting the decrease in AUM and sales volumes.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline linked to AUM contraction.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core business operations before taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income declined 7.6% in 2025 to $168.7 million, due to lower revenues and cost pressures.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to shareholders divided by diluted shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Diluted earnings per share increased 18.2% in 2025 to $19.97, driven by nonrecurring gains or more efficient capital management.
kpis.signal: Strong EPS growth despite declining revenues.

kpis.name: Net Flows
kpis.explanation: Difference between inflows and outflows of managed fund assets.
kpis.description: Net outflows totaled $18.9 billion in 2025 versus $10.4 billion in 2024, reflecting declining demand for the company's products.
kpis.signal: Significant net outflows in 2025, signaling competitive pressure or shifting investor preferences.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures to acquire stakes in specialized asset managers.
kpis.description: In December 2025, the company acquired a 35% stake in Crescent Cove Advisors for $41.1 million.
kpis.signal: Minority acquisition in Crescent Cove Advisors to strengthen private credit offerings.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets sourced from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €4.29 billion in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt sourced from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €2.84 billion in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Keystone National Group Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of a majority stake in a specialized manager focused on private credit backed by assets.
kpis.description: In December 2025, the company announced an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Keystone National Group for $200 million, with potential earnout of $170 million subject to future revenue targets.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into private credit, a high-growth segment.

risks.title: Dependence on technology systems and service interruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is cited first in the 'Risks Related to our Industry, Business and Operations' section. The language used ('negatively impact our business and profitability') indicates significant severity. This is a standard operational risk for technology-driven enterprises.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and governance risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity is a major focus, with dedicated governance at board and internal committee levels. The intensity of language and governance structure demonstrate elevated concern. This risk is critical for the technology sector.

risks.title: Financial market volatility and impact on asset values
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly linked to 'Market Developments' and impact on 'value of our assets under management'. References to 'fluctuation, volatility and declines' underscore severity. This is a major macroeconomic risk for asset management firms.

risks.title: Decline in assets under management and net flows
risks.score_rationale: Data shows significant AUM decline (8.9%) and increased negative net flows. Language in MD&A ('decrease', 'net outflows') indicates negative momentum. This risk directly impacts financial performance.

risks.title: Dependence on financial intermediaries for distribution
risks.score_rationale: Retail product distribution relies heavily on 'financial intermediaries'. Failure or strategy changes by these partners could impact distribution capacity. This risk is inherent to indirect distribution models.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The company recently acquired stakes and plans further acquisitions ('acquisition of a 35% minority interest', 'agreement to acquire a majority interest'). These transactions carry integration and target performance risks. This risk is tied to external growth strategy.

risks.title: Regulatory and client approval risks
risks.score_rationale: The Keystone acquisition is subject to 'necessary regulatory approvals and client approvals'. Regulatory changes or approval denials could delay or block strategic transactions. This risk is typical in the financial services sector.

ai_positioning.summary: VRTS does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Disclosed information focuses on financial and operational aspects of the business, with no reference to AI or its applications.
